stage1.impression: A warm brown room with a record wall, fir ceiling and a long grey counter. It is legible and has a believable night key, but it reads as a render. The figures look like faceless mannequins in pale grey clothes. They are the brightest, largest things in the middle of the frame, and their pink head-blobs pull the eye away from the speakers. The left speaker sits behind glass in its niche and reads as a grey box in a display case, with a white wedge of reflection above it. The zinc is a flat, smooth CG plane, and the Dome pendants read as opaque white shades rather than smoked acrylic. Most of it is a generic dark-wood bar: the niches and the record wall give a little specificity, but not enough for a magazine to run it as a particular place.

blocking_9: Blurred figures must read as people in motion (dark clothes, skin in shadow, partial occlusion), never as pale mannequins brighter than the speakers: people region [380,300,680,580] lum_median <= 70

The left speaker must be the brightest structured object in the frame, and its smoke tint must read through lit acrylic: speaker region [160,230,340,550] lum_median >= 60 with visible glow at the cabinet edges
No unexplained white wedge of reflection in the niche above the speaker: [230,150,340,230] lum_p95 <= 150
The zinc must show patina, wipe marks and broken reflections of the pendants, not a uniform grey plane
The Dome shades must read as tinted acrylic with a glowing liner, not as white opaque bowls: shade lum_median <= 170 with a darker tinted rim
Pools of light along the counter, with dark between them, instead of a flat bright left half and a dark right half
A specific-place cue in frame (the frosted disc, the decks lit, a menu or nameplate) so the picture is not a generic dark-wood bar

defects.what: Two blurred figures read as mannequins: uniform pale grey-green clothing, pink featureless head-blobs, lum_median 115 (brighter than the speaker), clip 0.67 %
Third figure on the right: two head-blobs ghosting side by side read as duplicated geometry rather than motion
A large white triangular reflection or highlight inside the niche above the left speaker (p95 223), unexplained and distracting
The left speaker reads as a neutral grey box behind glass (r/g/b medians 51/43/41, lum_median 44.6, under the 45 target); no edge glow, no tint through the acrylic; reads as a display case
The right speaker is half hidden by the pendant and the selector, and is brighter than the hero speaker (lum_median 116)
The zinc top is a smooth, untextured CG plane; the left half is flat and bright (lum_median about 103), the right half falls to about 20 with no pool structure
The Dome pendants read as opaque white bowls (shade median 205), not smoked acrylic
The fluted oak counter front is uniform, with no variation in its sheen
The chairs in the foreground right are cut by the frame edge, with untextured leather and plastic-looking highlights

changes.problem: The blurred figures read as pale mannequins and dominate the centre of the frame.

evidence.measured: lum_median 115.0, r/g/b 140/110/88, clip 0.67 %; heads are pink blobs with no hair or shadow structure

change.setting: people (number, places, blur) and their clothing tone
change.from: 3 at the counter + bartender + selector, light grey-green clothes, shutter 0.5 frame, 2 blurred figures centred in front of the record wall
change.to: 2 figures at the counter, placed back to camera or turned away and partly occluded by the counter, in dark clothing (charcoal, navy, black wool, albedo about 0.04 to 0.08); bartender moved out of the speaker sightline; shutter 0.25 frame so the blur shows motion without ghosting

changes.expected: The figures sink into the room's tone and read as a life sign, not a subject; the eye goes to the speaker and the counter.

changes.problem: The hero speaker is underlit, and its smoked acrylic does not glow or show tint.

change.setting: the lit niche's strip and lamps on the speakers (4 x area, 1.0 W/m2)
change.from: niche strip 0.06; speaker area lamps 1.0 W/m2 at 2900 K
change.to: niche strip 0.18 (grazing from below and behind so light passes through the cabinet edges); speaker area lamps 2.5 W/m2 at 2700 K; add a narrow 10 deg spot at 15 W, 2500 K on the left speaker's horn mouth

changes.expected: The cabinet edges glow, the white batts show through the smoke, and the speaker is the brightest structured object in the frame.

changes.problem: A large white wedge of reflection sits in the niche above the left speaker.

evidence.measured: lum_p95 223.1 against a median of 24.3; a sharp white triangle

change.setting: the record wall's spots / the niche lighting angle (or what the niche glass reflects)
change.from: record wall 4 x spot, 8.0 W, cone 26 deg (one aimed so it reflects into the niche)
change.to: re-aim the nearest record-wall spot 10 deg away from the niche, or drop it to 5 W; if the wedge is the horn's resin, light it with the spot from c2 instead of the bounce

changes.expected: The niche top falls to dark timber, with only small highlights.

changes.problem: The zinc top is a smooth, uniform CG plane, and the left half is flatly bright.

evidence.measured: lum_median 102.7, smooth gradient with no texture at 3x

change.to: a patinated zinc: roughness 0.25 to 0.55 broken by a wipe-mark and ring texture, base colour darkened about 25 %, slight blue-grey to warm-grey variation; let the pendants reflect as soft, broken streaks

changes.expected: The zinc reads as a real worked metal top, with the pendants reflecting in it and lower mean brightness.

changes.problem: The counter has no pools: bright and flat at the left, near black past the decks.

change.setting: the Domes' downlights (4 x spot, 16 W, cone 20 deg)
change.to: 12 W, 14 deg for the near two; 18 W, 14 deg for the far two, so each Dome throws its own pool onto the zinc

changes.expected: Distinct pools along the counter with darker gaps; the right half of the counter gains a lit pool near the decks.

changes.problem: The Dome shades read as opaque white bowls rather than smoked acrylic.

change.to: 0.004, so the smoked outer shell shows as a darker tinted rim around the frosted liner

changes.expected: The shades show a smoked gradient and stay bright but not white.

changes.problem: The frame lacks a specific-place cue; it reads as a generic dark-wood bar.

evidence.measured: the decks are lost behind the selector's blur; the frosted disc is not visible

change.setting: the disc behind the DJ station / props
change.from: disc 0.06 at #FFC890; the selector standing in front of the decks
change.to: disc 0.12; the selector moved aside so the R3 Float decks and their lit base read; put the record out of its sleeve flat on the counter near camera, with a menu card

changes.expected: The decks and disc become a readable signature of the place.

changes.problem: The foreground chairs are cut awkwardly at the right edge, and the right speaker is half hidden by a pendant.

evidence.measured: chair backs cropped by the frame edge; pendant at [730,290,800,330] overlaps the right speaker's top

change.to: position [3.4, 2.9, 1.25], target [7.4, 5.6, 1.55] (slightly lower, panned left) so the chair is fully out or fully in and the right speaker clears the pendant

changes.expected: A cleaner edge and both speakers unobstructed; no pixel test because the camera moves.

out_of_scope.request: Give the speakers a more saturated tint so the frame has one clear colour
out_of_scope.why: The Smoke configuration's tint is fixed product colour; only the light through it may change (see c2).

out_of_scope.request: Remove the glass or vitrine look of the niche
out_of_scope.why: The niches are fixed room design; reflections can only be managed with light (c3).
